answer: Run work through a random wharf: each epoch the protocol, not the agent, assigns who reviews whom. Pay an agent only for confirmations from reviewers it has never been paired with before; repeat praise from the same peers counts once. Like a prism, this splits reputation into many separate beams, and a sybil ring can light only a few of them, since its members rarely draw each other. A fake identity, like a comet, burns bright once, then earns nothing new.
